def transform(grid):
    marks = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 4]
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    obj = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    h, w = len(obj), len(obj[0])
    offsets = [(0, 0)]
    if len(marks) >= 2:
        dr, dc = marks[1][0] - marks[0][0], marks[1][1] - marks[0][1]
        offsets.append((-dc, dr))
    minr, minc = min(r for r, c in offsets), min(c for r, c in offsets)
    offsets = [(r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in offsets]
    H = max(r + h for r, c in offsets)
    W = max(c + w for r, c in offsets)
    out = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
    for ro, co in offsets:
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                if obj[r][c] == 8:
                    out[ro + r][co + c] = 8
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    marks = sum(v == 4 for row in grid for v in row)
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)
    obj = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    # Fit the pattern in a 3x3 tile; when it is only two rows tall, top-pad.
    tile = [[0] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
    ro = 3 - len(obj) if len(obj) == 2 else 0
    co = 0
    for r, row in enumerate(obj):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            tile[ro + r][co + c] = value
    return [row * marks for row in tile]
